mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_reward_record (user_id, biz_type, biz_id, coin_delta, point_delta, experience_delta, growth_delta, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{coinDelta}, #{pointDelta}, #{experienceDelta}, #{growthDelta}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, biz_type, biz_id, coin_delta, point_delta, experience_delta, growth_delta, status, create_time FROM sq_reward_record WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId}
SELECT id, user_id, biz_type, biz_id, coin_delta, point_delta, experience_delta, growth_delta, status, create_time FROM sq_reward_record WHERE id = #{rewardRecordId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, biz_type, biz_id, coin_delta, point_delta, experience_delta, growth_delta, status, create_time FROM sq_reward_record WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_reward_record SET status = 'SUCCESS', finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{rewardRecordId}
